data.summary:
Regulatory Reporting & Quality Assurance (QA) professional with 8+ years of experience in global financial institutions, specializing in QA governance, data validation, and control frameworks across regulatory reporting (SFTR, EMIR, MiFID II).
Proven expertise in sample testing, reconciliation, audit readiness, and risk & control frameworks, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of regulatory submissions across complex financial products and client portfolios.

raw_sections.summary:
PROFILE SUMMARY
Regulatory Reporting & Quality Assurance (QA) professional with 8+ years of experience in global financial institutions, specializing in QA governance, data validation, and control frameworks across regulatory reporting (SFTR, EMIR, MiFID II).
Proven expertise in sample testing, reconciliation, audit readiness, and risk & control frameworks, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of regulatory submissions across complex financial products and client portfolios.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Regulatory Reporting (SFTR, EMIR, MiFID II – exposure)
Project & Program Management
Stakeholder Management (Business, Tech, Compliance)
Root Cause Analysis & Issue Resolution
QA Framework Design & Governance
Sample Testing & Data Validation
Data Quality Metrics & Monitoring
SQL & Advanced Excel
Regulatory Change Implementation
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Standard Chartered Global Business Services – Manager, Non-Financial Regulatory Reporting | Nov 2024- Aug 2026 • Led end-to-end migration of NFRR Regulatory Reports across Africa and the Middle East ensuring seamless transition.
Implemented review processes ensuring full regulatory reporting compliance.
Partnered with technology teams to automate reporting and improve efficiency.
Lead QA governance and control framework for regulatory reporting
Designed QA testing frameworks and validation mechanisms
Developed reconciliation controls ensuring data integrity
Acted as audit and QA review point of contact
Deutsche Bank – Associate, SFTR Regulatory Reporting | Feb 2023– Nov 2024 | Bengaluru, India
Led end-to-end migration of SFTR regulatory reporting processes, ensuring seamless transition with zero regulatory breaches.
Managed end-to-end regulatory reporting of BAU activities, ensuring accurate and timely submission of reports in compliance with
regulatory requirements and internal SLAs.
Monitored daily reporting exceptions, performed root cause analysis, and collaborated with Technology, Operations, and Business teams to resolve issues within agreed timelines.
Gathered, analyzed, and documented business requirements for regulatory reporting enhancements, production fixes, and regulatory change initiatives.
Conducted impact assessments for new regulatory requirements and system changes, translating business needs into functional requirements for Technology teams.
Worked closely with cross-functional stakeholders to define reporting logic, validation rules, data mapping, and control requirements.
Performed reconciliations between source systems and trade repositories to identify reporting discrepancies and ensure data accuracy.
Supported UAT by preparing test scenarios, executing business validation, reviewing defects, and providing sign-off for production releases.
Partnered with Development, QA, Compliance, and global Operations teams throughout the project lifecycle to ensure successful implementation of regulatory reporting changes.
Investigated data quality issues and reporting breaks, recommended corrective actions, and drove process improvements to strengthen reporting controls.
Prepared Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), user stories, process flows, SOPs, and operational documentation.
J.P. Morgan – Senior Analyst, Client Reporting | Nov 2020 – Feb 2023 | Bengaluru, India
• Managed end-to-end delivery of client reports and commentaries across all asset classes, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and
timely dissemination within agreed service level timelines.
Acted as a key point of contact for client and auditor queries, providing prompt, accurate, and professional responses to maintain strong relationships and compliance.
Led initiatives to automate client reporting processes, reduce manual intervention and improve efficiency, scalability, and data integrity.
Collaborated with clients to understand bespoke reporting requirements and ensure successful Integrating customizations into standard reporting workflows.
Supported client onboarding and lifecycle management, ensuring seamless setup, reporting alignment, and continuous service improvements.
Worked closely with Client Account Managers and Investment Specialists to enhance the overall client experience by aligning reporting outputs with client expectations and strategic objectives.
State Street Syntel – Analyst | May 2017 | Nov 2020 | Pune, India
Performance and Attribution Team.
Responsible for delivery of all client performance reports and attribution accurately and within specified timeframes.
Conduct client analysis and take feedback from clients on a regular basis and work towards betterment of services. Responsible for taking ownership of all process related documents and keep track of it.
Provide the performance numbers to different clients and escalate data related queries and issues with the data specialist in the team.
Index data Management and reporting Team
Responsible for Index management
Creation of Standard Index and Custom indices and appropriate mapping it to the portfolios.
Distributing all client reports to client, standard, and custom reports based on client requirements.
Transaction management Team
Performing monthly reconciliation for Cash
Research on the exception to find out the exact reason for exception lying on account
Act as per client instructions through AD HOC, working for client request services
